mirrorworld.request.hint: Your reflection presses against the glass and points at: %s × %s
mirrorworld.merge.done: The mirror shatters and the two worlds merge. %s changes from the other side are now part of your world.
mirrorworld.merge.empty: The mirror shatters. Your reflection steps out into your world.
mirrorworld.letter.page1:
Hello, other me.

I could see you every day through the glass. At first I could only copy you... then I learned to move on my own.
mirrorworld.letter.page2:
Thank you for helping me build this house. Now that the glass is gone it belongs to both of us.

- Your Reflection
mirrorworld.reflection.line0: Everything here feels... the wrong way round.
mirrorworld.reflection.line1: Do you like my house? You carried half of it through the glass.
mirrorworld.reflection.line2: I left something for you in the chest.
mirrorworld.reflection.line3: Why do you raise your right hand when I raise my left?
mirrorworld.reflection.line4: It was very quiet on the other side.
mirrorworld.reflection.line5: Please don't build another mirror. I don't want to go back.
mirrorworld.reflection.line6: I still catch myself copying you sometimes.
mirrorworld.reflection.line7: Our worlds had the same mountains, did you know?
